preflight.guardrail_note: Read-only audit; only existing registered engines were evaluated.

basic.leakage_risk: low if target price is excluded from features

geographic.leakage_risk: medium because sparse geography can memorize locations

house.leakage_risk: medium because product classification may reflect price-language proxies

temporal.leakage_risk: medium/high if last_seen or future refresh data is used
temporal.production_calculable: scraped_at yes; publication date mostly no

aggregated_possible.leakage_risk: high unless fitted only on train and cutoff-aware
aggregated_possible.production_calculable: yes only through versioned offline transformers

risks: Small effective sample after canonical target filtering, especially apartments.
Microzone and lat/lon coverage are too sparse for high-cardinality geography.
Zonal aggregate features must be fitted on train only to avoid target leakage.
House land features are too sparse and would mostly learn missingness.

random_reproducible.reason: 1534 canonical rows allow random train/validation/test, but it is optimistic.

temporal.reason: Viable only as a rough active-listing split; not a full historical backtest.

by_comuna_holdout.reason: Useful stress test, but scarce communes will dominate instability.

train_validation_test.reason: Viable globally; segment-specific validation remains weak for apartments and land-rich houses.

land_value.reason: Requires hundreds of land-rich houses and multiple dense communes; current sample is too small.

building_value.reason: Requires hundreds of land-rich houses and multiple dense communes; current sample is too small.

depreciation.reason: No reliable age/condition variable in Listing entity.

land_building_interaction.reason: Current ratio sample is far below a stable interaction model.

comuna_effect.reason: Most communes have too few land-rich house rows.

microzone_effect.reason: Microzone sample is not enough for land/building separation.

house_land_building.methodological_warning: Current land_area coverage is too sparse to separate land and construction value.

valoria_consensus.diagnosis: The skeleton uses real contracts, but it is not registered and depends on precomputed base EngineResult objects plus calibrated weights that do not exist yet. With only legacy and canonical variants, consensus would be selection logic rather than a real ensemble.
future_rewrite_conditions: At least two real non-variant engines, ideally three, with comparable benchmarks.
Same dataset signature, target rules, UF rate and split across engines.
Segmented validation metrics and calibrated confidence.
Versioned exclusion rules and disagreement handling.
Evidence that the ensemble beats or stabilizes the best individual motor.

roadmap.name: Stabilize canonical_plus_outliers as a practical challenger variant
roadmap.coverage: high for houses relative to canonical_full

roadmap.name: Improve data before heavier new engines: land_area, microzone, geocode, apartment canonical target
Implement hedonic_house_minimal as a limited offline pilot before full ML
Run ML as laboratory only after a clean validation plan
Defer house_land_building
roadmap.coverage: too low with current land coverage

roadmap.name: Rewrite valoria_consensus after 2-3 real engines exist
